newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hershey Foods Q4 96 estimate upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hershey Foods Q4 96 estimate upped.

text.p: -- Everen Securities said on Wednesday it raised its fourth-quarter 1996 earnings estimate for Hershey Foods to $0.76 from $0.74 per share. The firm earned $0.67 per share during the same period last year.
-- Analyst Richard Elam said he also raised Hershey's full-year 1996 estimate to $2.02 and his 1997 estimate by $0.03 to $2.28.
-- He raised the price objectives to $55 and $60, from $51 and $56 "to account for better earnings visibility."

-- Elam said talks with Hershey management indicated "very strong" Halloween candy sales and holiday-season candy orders. He also cited expectations of higher sales due to orders for Hershey's new boxed "Pot of Gold" candy.
-- Declining durum wheat prices should help profitability in Hershey's pasta division, he added.
-- "The stock is fully valued but would be attractive at lower prices," Elam wrote.
-- Hershey Foods shares on Wednesday closed off 5/8 at 50-1/4. --Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787
